title: Data Analyst
description:
About the role
Analyse customer and transaction data, build reproducible analyses and explain findings to non-technical stakeholders.

We use Azure for internal reporting.

Requirements:
- Python
- SQL
- pandas
- statistics
- 2+ years of experience in a data role

Preferred:
- Machine learning
- Forecasting
- Docker

We require a bachelor's degree and the right to work in Spain.
